No. 176/2016 under Section 363/376(2) (i) & (n) IPC readwith 6 of POCSO Act, registered at P.S. Subzi Mandi, Delhi.
2. Issue notice.
Notice accepted by the learned APP appearing for the State.

3. Notice be also issued to the prosecutrix through the Investigating Officer (I.O.).
3. Admit.
4. List in due course.
5. Registry is directed to requisition the Trial Court Record in digital This is a digitally signed order.

6.
